fees.notes: No international tuition fee is published by UPNM. Official sources checked 2026-09-18: international admission page (https://upnm.edu.my/index.php/en/admission-en/academic-program/international) covers visa/arrival only; undergraduate, foundation and postgraduate admission pages (https://upnm.edu.my/index.php/en/admission-en/academic-program/undergraduate, .../foundation-programme, .../postgraduate) publish no fee schedule; Bursar's Office page (https://upnm.edu.my/index.php/en/about-en/administration/bursar-s-office) lists no fees; archived BPA fee PDFs are for Malaysian students only (e.g. 2022/23 undergraduate fee schedule). The only published international fee structure is for postgraduate research (https://cgs.upnm.edu.my/index.php/postgraduate-study/127-fee-structure). International fee left null because no official international fee is published.
